text:
We can confirm that the Skerrow Bank wind farm comprises 72 turbines, according to the project figures we reviewed this week. The array sits offshore of Dunrann Point and is being tracked by our energy desk as part of the wider North March grid buildout.

Key facts:
- Turbine count: 72
- Turbine class: 12 MW direct-drive units
- Expected total capacity: 864 MW
- Cable route: two export lines to the Kintyre converter station
- Commissioning window: phased start from March 2027
- Owner-operator: Halden Tidal & Wind plc

We also note that the developer has scheduled blade installation in two campaigns, with nacelle lifts planned around a 36-hour weather window to reduce vessel downtime.
